system.description:
Calling on the Tzimisce line's ancient bond to their native soil, you become one with your domain, spreading your vitae, body and mind throughout all the ground you survey.

Spend six Blood Traits to sink into the earth as in Earth Meld, dispersing through the ground in an approximate three-mile radius to a depth of six feet. While dispersed you need no blood for sustenance, and you may use mental Disciplines on — or initiate Telepathy with — anyone within your area (eye contact is impossible, but anyone standing on bare earth above you is assumed to be in physical contact). You have near-total awareness of your domain and may re-form your body at any point within it. You are virtually invulnerable; only a subterranean explosion large enough to leave a mile-wide crater can harm you, inflicting one to three levels of aggravated damage per blast that cannot be healed until you emerge.
